title: pm-dispatch lanes/hotcrm.md:8 and :33 still forbid the repo:hotcrm seat to grade and point at a dead "SKILL.md 多仓协调规则 4": align them with the single-lane rule, as ruled on hotcrm#2178 (A)
body:
**Filing gate ③:** a task the maintainer's ruling directs. On objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2178 the maintainer ruled 「A」 (recorded in comment `6265194393`, matching the director's delta `6264888052`): the `repo:hotcrm` seat grades its lane's cards at first touch, and the skills lane aligns the charter text. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`os-project-manager`, session `session_01BDgipbNowaGa139em8Fhoq`). ⛔ Not a claim.
**Reader who acts:** the `domain:skills` lane seat, in one text PR.
**Dedupe:** objectstack issues searched for "lanes/hotcrm.md charter grading pointer 多仓协调规则 dead pointer cross-repo-coordination": 42 hits, 0 open on point. The nearest are #11516 (closed; the charter's half-state-patrol line) and #18019 (closed; other lines left behind by a charter revision).

## What is wrong (objectstack `main`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/`)

- `lanes/hotcrm.md:8`: "⛔ 不产 `domain:*`、type 与定级，纪律全文在 SKILL.md 多仓协调规则 4。"
  - The pointer is dead. `grep -c '多仓协调规则' ../SKILL.md` answers 0, because the multi-repo text moved to `cross-repo-coordination.md` in the principle-only rewrite (`f151ef2c9`).
  - The rule it carries is the 2026-08-16 three-repo wording (objectstack-ai/objectstack#9131: triage grades objectstack, objectui and cloud; sister seats "never mint grades"). That ruling never covered hotcrm.
- `lanes/hotcrm.md:33`: "定级归分诊或维护者，本席只供证据。" It contradicts the single-lane rule.
- `cross-repo-coordination.md:9-10`: "单车道仓 `repo:*` 席自理机械三务 … 机械三务 = 自扫 sweep、自打 `type`、自做 `finding` 首触定级。" This is the rule hotcrm#2178 ruled to apply.

## What to change (the ruling's 口径, verbatim from `6264888052`)

> the skills lane opens one text PR on `lanes/hotcrm.md:8` and `:33` (pointer to `cross-repo-coordination.md`, the grading sentence aligned), ⛔ nothing else in that PR.

- `:8` points at `cross-repo-coordination.md`'s single-lane rule, and it no longer says the seat produces no grade.
- `:33` says the seat grades at first touch by `filing-gate.md`'s 定级判据, with the reason posted on the card and open to the maintainer's veto.

**Not in this PR, for the author to read:** `lanes/hotcrm.md:51` ("`domain:*` 与 type 留给分诊") also differs from the single-lane rule, on `type`. The 口径 says nothing else goes in this PR, so it is recorded here and stays out.

## Acceptance

- `grep -c '多仓协调规则' .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/hotcrm.md` answers 0.
- `lanes/hotcrm.md` and `cross-repo-coordination.md` agree on who grades a hotcrm card.
- The PR body quotes the ruling (hotcrm#2178, `6265194393`) and the 口径.
- The line ratchet and id-lint guards pass. This is a `.claude/**` Tier S text change.
